followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the included designated-crossing restriction regime, with no admissible current dated phase. The evidence supports differentiated restrictions and operating corridors, not a uniform long closure of the entire Sudan–South Sudan boundary. The four listed prospective opening posts are contextual locations, not four proven continuously closed facilities. Jebelein–Renk trade and the UN’s functioning-corridor account require explicit operating exceptions. Replace the generic enforcement cell with that distinction. Remove the unsupported Dimensions last-confirmed closure date of 27 October 2021 and its blanket status sentence. The failed October launch is not closure confirmation. Keep zero phases and no duration; the pre-window 2016 decree cannot establish one later onset. Keep conflict, territorial and diplomatic categories as qualified analytical context. Replace generic rationale assurances with actor- and period-limited qualifications. Freshly inspected material does not establish all three as official motives at every post or throughout every year. Sudans Post supplies a named official’s trade account, Radio Tamazuj the stalled ceremony and local difficulties, Sudan Tribune pre-window decree context, and the UN an indexed primary operating-corridor passage. Direct UN PDF failures remain disclosed. H06 has no phase-location rows. Retain named-crossing text without coordinates or a whole-boundary line. The four-post announcement and the four-of-ten operating count are not assumed to enumerate the same set.
